Jack plans to study music harder this term. At first, Jack found it difficult to keep the habit. On Sunday evenings, Jack reviews the notes from class. The baby is awake at six every morning.

Jack wrote down every idea in a small notebook. People around Jack often share different ideas about the volunteer team. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Best of all, the chess club welcomes outsiders, unlike the clique at lunch.
